title: Reject cancellation of terminal GMCP tasks
goal: Make the GMCP task manager reject cancellation requests for completed, failed, and cancelled tasks with invalid_params, without mutating their state or timestamps, while preserving cooperative cancellation for active tasks.

reuse.searched: Inspected the existing crates/susi-gmcp TaskManager and TaskStatus implementation, the pinned local task contract docs/gmcp/contract-203-004.md clause MCP-2025-1125-basic-utilities-tasks-mdx-0494, the checked-in GMCP task specification, and current Board claims. The existing manager and locked dependency graph are sufficient; no new dependency or harvested source is needed.
reuse.reason: This is a bounded correction to the existing GMCP task lifecycle and reuses its current terminal-status predicate, error type, and unit-test harness.

limitations: Acceptance is run on the native Linux x86_64 host; no Windows run in this lane.
The change covers tasks/cancel terminal-state validation only; other GMCP task or transport gaps remain out of scope.
